newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Roadway Express upped.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Roadway Express upped.

text.p: -- Schroder Wertheim said on Monday it had upgraded its rating for Roadway Express Inc to outperform from perform in line.
-- Analyst Gary Yablon wrote in a report that the reasons for the upgrade included "continued cost improvement."
-- He added, "Over the past couple of weeks the stock has dropped from $17 while conviction from management about improving trends has increased.
-- "We expect the stock will retrace (possibly quickly). Upside is in the 20 percent range -- good trading opportunity."
- The company's stock closed on Monday up 3/8 to 14-1/2.
